The '''Tythonian reptilian''' was a [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]], bipedal [[Reptile/Legends|reptile]] native to the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] known as [[Tython/Legends|Tython]].

==Biology and appearance==
A blue-skinned reptilian beast resembling a spinosaurid dinosaur, the creaturre stood over well over twice the average height of a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]]. Standing on its two hind legs, the raptor had three talons on each foot as well as on its two short arms. Its spine was ridged with short spikes which started at the crown of the head and traced the spine back all the way to the terminus of the raptor's tail. The raptor had a long snout and a mouth filled with a singe row of sharp, pointed teeth. The skin of the raptor appeared to crackle with a blue, ambient [[Force energy]].

==Tythonian reptilians in the galaxy==
Native to the planet of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]], the raptors were discovered by the early [[Je'daii Order]] when they first settled the jungle world. At least on one occasion, an encounter with the Order ended in confrontation. An [[Iktotchi/Legends|Iktotchi]] and a Human Je'daii wielded [[Sword/Legends|swords]] against two raptors amid the planet's jungles.
